title: Kaplansky decomposition into countably generated projectives
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $P$ be a projective $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. There exist a set $I$, projective $R$-modules $P_i$ for $i\in I$, and an $R$-linear isomorphism $\bigoplus_{i\in I}P_i\cong P$, such that every $P_i$ is countably generated: it has an at most countable subset whose finite $R$-linear combinations exhaust $P_i$. Here $\bigoplus_{i\in I}P_i$ is the module of families $(x_i)_{i\in I}$ with $x_i\in P_i$ and only finitely many nonzero coordinates, with componentwise operations. No finite-generation hypothesis is imposed on $P$.
